title: StatusData
description:
`status` result — the one orientation read: the sessions, the resolved trust-rail table for
the current directory (the person's profile layers itemized beside the manifests'), per-agent
trigger arm state, and the binary version. Computed ENTIRELY from local state (no network).
**INFERRED** (additive-only).

awaiting_first_sync.description:
Profile deliveries not yet applied on this machine (never reconciled here — the next
`topos update` applies them). Absent = not cheaply knowable from local state.

detail.description: The deep single-bundle answer (`topos status <bundle>`): where it comes from, spelled.

items.description:
The resolved table for the CURRENT directory: every bundle the scopes covering it — the
nearest project manifest and the person scope (the global manifest, or each connected
workspace's feed) — resolve to, deduped per scope, each with its one source line and an
honest state; recorded `"off"` switches appear as their own rows.

notes.description:
The disclosure lines — plain sentences the table cannot carry per row: the loud
no-feed-row note, redundant rows, inert `"off"` switches, set-collision winners,
declined-but-delivered notes, cross-scope version splits. Rendered verbatim.

profile_skills.description:
Skills the person's server-stored PROFILES deliver to this installation, counted from the
offline delivery cache (withdrawn and manifest-channel rows excluded).

regimes.description:
Each connected workspace's REGIME on this machine: adopting its whole feed, explicit
line-by-line control, or feed rows withheld by a hand-written global manifest.

server.description: The server base URL the sessions dial, when logged in.

sessions.description:
This installation's SESSIONS — one per logged-into workspace (the session model; empty =
logged into nothing).

signed_in.description: Whether a LIVE (non-ended) session's credential is stored — the signed-in state.

triggers.description:
Per-agent auto-update trigger state, probed READ-ONLY over the detected agents (nothing is
armed or repaired by `status`).

StatusDetail.description: The deep answer for ONE bundle (`topos status <bundle>`). **INFERRED** (additive-only).

attribution.description: The delivery attribution (`assigned by <name>` / `picked by you`), when known.

feed.description:
The feed origin, when no row names it (`<host>/<workspace>` — the workspace whose feed
delivers it).

pin.description: A row's version pin, when one is spelled.

placements.description: The placement directories this machine holds for it.

source_file.description: The manifest FILE whose row delivers it, when a row does (a path).

source_key.description: The row's spelled KEY in that file (the joined reference).

state.description: The line's state (the same vocabulary as the table).

version.description: The applied version (64-hex), when applied locally.

StatusItem.description:
One resolved line of the trust rail. Every "why does this agent have X?" is answered by
`source` (which manifest line — or profile — asked for it); every "why doesn't it?" by
`state` (an exclude renders as its own row). **INFERRED** (additive-only).

applied_as_of.description:
When the applied state was last confirmed against a delivery (RFC-3339 UTC) — the offline
cache's honesty stamp: "applied as of this sync", never a live claim.

attribution.description: The delivery attribution, when known (`assigned by <name>` / `picked by you`).

scope.description:
Where the bytes belong: `"project"` (this project's harness dirs) or `"person"` (the home
dirs).

shadows.description:
Broader mentions this line shadows (their labels) — on an `excluded` row, the layers
whose provision the exclude withholds. Rendered, never acted on.

source.description:
ONE source line: the manifest that asked for it (`<dir>/topos.toml`,
`~/.topos/topos.toml`), or the profile layer (`your profile @ <host>/<ws>`). On an
`excluded` row, the layer that RECORDED the exclude.

version.description: The applied version (64-hex), when one is applied locally.

via.description:
The channel that delivers it, when the line rides one (`everyone` = the workspace
baseline).

StatusItemState.description: A trust-rail line's state. **INFERRED value set** (additive).

oneOf.description:
The bytes are applied and current against the last-known delivered target (see
`applied_as_of` — the offline cache's stamp, not a live confirmation).
A newer target is known than what is applied — the next `update` lands it.
Local edits sit ahead of the applied version (a draft).
An exclude line withholds this name here (the row's `source` recorded it).

A machine-local `"off"` row in the global manifest withholds this bundle from the feed
here (the everywhere-path is the web decline).

Referenced here but NOT deliverable with your current access — phrased from LOCAL
knowledge only (no live session for its workspace); never from server confirmation.
The session that would deliver it is pending an owner's approval.

Not applied here yet — `topos update` applies it (or the state is not determinable
offline).

StatusRegime.description: One workspace's regime line in a [`StatusData`]. **INFERRED** (additive-only).

regime.description:
The regime sentence (e.g. "adopting all assigned, 2 off" or "explicit: 3 bundles; 1
assigned not adopted here").

StatusSession.description:
One session in a [`StatusData`] — this installation logged into one workspace. **INFERRED**
(additive-only).

host.description: The server host the workspace lives on (the manifest grammar's host half).

name.description: The ADDRESS name (what you logged in by).

session_status.description:
The session's status, when it is NOT plainly active: `"pending"` (awaiting an owner's
approval — delivery starts automatically once approved) or `"ended"` (revoked or gone —
`topos login <address>` starts a fresh one). Absent = active.

StatusTrigger.description:
One detected agent's auto-update trigger presence in a [`StatusData`] — a read-only probe of
the same artifact the arming sweep manages. **INFERRED** (additive-only).

armed.description:
Provable presence of the topos trigger artifact right now. Absent = unknowable without a
live probe `status` refuses to run (a scheduler that must be dialed to answer).

note.description: A short honesty note (e.g. why `armed` is unknown), when one is needed.
